palette.primary_role: Deep brand colors for headings and dark feature bands. Starbucks green (#006241) and Sweetgreen green (#00473c) for farm-to-table brand moments. Cafe brown (#5d4432) for warmth. Uber black (#000000) for delivery/urban energy. Chipotle maroon (#451400) for earthy Mexican-grill identity — used as text color site-wide, not just headings. Dig Inn green (#005740) for seasonal healthy food brand. Dark greens, browns, and near-blacks anchor food brands.
palette.accent_role: CTAs, rewards badges, and ordering actions. Starbucks Green Accent (#00754a) for all CTAs. Gold (#cba258) reserved for Rewards ceremony. Sweetgreen neon green (#e6ff55) is a bold, unmistakable CTA accent on dark green backgrounds — highly distinctive. Chipotle brand red (#ad2118) for urgency-driven ORDER NOW CTAs. Chipotle gold (#b68207) for secondary text links. Dig Inn light green (#a8d6ae) for accent sections and app download panels. Uber uses pure black for delivery CTAs.
palette.surface_role: Warm cream/off-white canvases dominate across all brands. Sweetgreen cream (#f4f3e7) is the farm-table base surface. Sweetgreen sage (#d8e5d6) and warm peach (#e8dcc6) provide subtle section variation. Sweetgreen dark header (#0e1512) creates an inverted nav. Chipotle uses pure white (#ffffff) and light gray (#f0f0f0). Dig Inn alternates near-black sections (#1a1a1a, #161616) with mint (#e6f0e7), cream (#f9f6eb), and light green (#a8d6ae) — a dark/light color-block rhythm. Shake Shack sticks to white dominant. White for cards across all brands. Dark green/black for feature bands and footers.
palette.neutral_role: Warm-toned text, never pure black for body (exceptions: Shake Shack, Dig Inn). Starbucks uses 87% opacity black for softer reading on cream. Cafe uses warm dark brown (#3e2b1e). Chipotle uses #451400 (maroon) for ALL body text — unique among restaurants, creating an earthy, warm reading experience. Sweetgreen uses dark green (#0e1512) for body text and gray (#696969) for meta/labels. Dig Inn uses near-black (#161616) for body on light surfaces, white on dark sections. Shake Shack uses pure black text.
palette.border_role: Subtle warm-toned borders for form inputs and card separators. Uber uses stark black borders intentionally — the only brand with high-contrast borders. Most restaurant brands minimize visible borders, preferring color-block separation.

border_radius.sharp: 0px-4px (Sweetgreen uses 0px for cards and text buttons; Chipotle uses 4px universally for all buttons and inputs — a major exception to the restaurant pill convention)
border_radius.rounded: 12px (content cards, product tiles — the universal card radius for food brands)
border_radius.pill_small: 30px-32px (Shake Shack 30px for primary CTA, Dig Inn 32px for secondary 'Order Now' and 'Order catering')
border_radius.pill_large: 50px-60px (Dig Inn primary 'Order Now' at 60px — extra generous pill for statement CTAs)
border_radius.pill_extreme: 1000px (Sweetgreen 'Order now' — effectively a full pill on wide buttons)
border_radius.typical_button: Varies by brand strategy. Sweetgreen: 1000px pill for CTAs. Chipotle: 4px sharp (industry outlier — rectangular, not pill). Shake Shack: 30px pill. Dig Inn: 60px (primary) / 32px (secondary). Starbucks: 50px. Uber: 999px. The 'universal pill' rule has exceptions — Chipotle proves sharp rectangles work in fast-casual.
border_radius.typical_card: 12px — consistent across Starbucks, Cafe, Uber. Sweetgreen and Chipotle use 0px (no radius, flat edge-to-edge).

button_styles.bg: brand green, brand red, or black
button_styles.text: Order now, Add to order, Reserve, Explore menu, ORDER NOW, Build your own bowl
Learn more, Start an order, See menu, SIGN IN
Join now, Sign in, Get the app, Order Now, Order catering
Order now, Let us know, Find out more

elevation.shadows: whisper-soft layered shadows (Starbucks, Uber) or flat (Cafe, Sweetgreen, Chipotle, Dig Inn)
elevation.approach: Starbucks uses 2-3 layer low-alpha shadows for cards and floating CTAs. Uber uses single low-opacity shadows (rgba(0,0,0,0.12-0.16)) for minimal lift. Sweetgreen, Chipotle, Shake Shack, and Dig Inn are entirely flat (no box-shadows on cards). Modern fast-casual brands prefer color-block alternation over shadow-based depth. Depth primarily comes from color-block section alternation and dark/light rhythm.
typical_values: none (Sweetgreen, Chipotle, Shake Shack, Dig Inn — flat design)

typical_order: header (sticky, logo left, nav links center, CTA buttons right — inverted dark header for Sweetgreen, transparent for Dig Inn, white for Chipotle)
promotional_strip (optional top banner — 'Free shipping on orders over $X', 'New spring menu')
hero (varies by brand: cream editorial, white video-centered, slider carousel, or dark statement)
category_navigation (horizontal scroll of menu categories — Sweetgreen uses ultra-light 48px transparent tabs, Chipotle uses anchor-links to menu sections)
menu_grid (3-4 column grid of product cards — photo, name, description, price, add-to-order button)
feature_band (full-width dark section — Dig Inn uses #1a1a1a near-black, Sweetgreen uses dark green #0e1512, Chipotle uses white with video background)
rewards_loyalty (status tiers — points system, benefits list — Chipotle Rewards, Dig Inn Rewards)
gift_cards (illustrated card grid with physical-card photography feel — Shake Shack has Shack Store)
testimonials (customer quotes, review ratings — Dig Inn has a dedicated review content block with mint #e6f0e7 background)
app_download (QR code + app store badges, phone mockup — Dig Inn uses light green #a8d6ae background)
newsletter_cta (email signup with incentive — Sweetgreen, Dig Inn)
footer (4-6 column: menu, about, careers, social impact, legal, region selector)
hero_variants: split_warm (Starbucks style — 40% product photo right, 60% text left, cream canvas, green accents)
dark_feature_band (full-width #1e3932 dark green, white text, product photo + CTAs)
cozy_minimal (Cafe style — #f9f7f5 warm surface, brown typography, clean centered layout)
urban_bold (Uber Eats style — black/white contrast, 52px UberMove Bold, pill CTAs, delivery-focused)

editorial_confident (Sweetgreen style — #f4f3e7 cream canvas, 16px h1 at 400 weight, dark green text #00473c, neon green #e6ff55 CTA pill, product photography on warm tile backgrounds — tiny type that reads as supremely confident)
video_centered (Chipotle style — full-width video background, white overlay, 33.6px h1 in maroon #451400, brand-red #ad2118 ORDER NOW button at 20px with 4px sharp radius)
slider_carousel (Shake Shack style — Slick slider with full-bleed 2880x1040 photography, 47px Jost bold h1, 30px pill black CTA, minimal overlay)
statement_dark (Dig Inn style — 90px Flama 750-weight h1 in white on dark/transparent background, 120px h2, 60px green pill CTA — type IS the hero, photography is background)
feature_card_variants: menu_product_card (photography top, name + description + price + add button below, 12px radius or 0px flat)
rewards_status_card (dark panel, tier badge, benefits list, progress bar)
gift_card_tile (illustrated photograph fills entire card, subtle drop shadow, physical card feel)
category_image_card (full-bleed food/drink photography with text overlay)
two_up_image_reveal (Sweetgreen — side-by-side columns, one with text and padding, one full-bleed image, scroll-triggered image reveal animation)
integrated_content_block (Dig Inn — alternating image+text blocks, right-aligned or left-aligned image, dark #1a1a1a background, white text, site-button CTAs)
word_marquee (Dig Inn — full-width black #000000 section with scrolling text banner)

tone_profile.headline_style: benefit-driven, warm and welcoming, 3-7 words (e.g., 'Free coffee is just the beginning', 'Explore our spring menu', 'Order delivery near you', 'Inspiring healthier communities', 'CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN')
tone_profile.cta_style: action-oriented ordering verbs (Order now, ORDER NOW, Add to order, Explore menu, Start an order, Build your own bowl, Reserve, Join now). Chipotle uses ALL-CAPS UPPERCASE for primary CTAs creating urgency. Sweetgreen uses sentence case for a softer, more editorial feel. Dig Inn alternates green and black pill CTAs by hierarchy.
trust_signals: food ethics / mission pages (Chipotle 'Our Values', Dig Inn 'Our Mission', Sweetgreen 'Our Mission')
anti_patterns: pure white backgrounds without warmth (unless Chipotle-style earth tones in text compensate)
no food/drink photography above the fold
aggressive sales language (except Chipotle's ALL-CAPS which is brand-appropriate)
complex navigation that hides the menu
low-contrast CTA buttons that blend into the background

color_mood: warm_green_cafe (Starbucks: #f2f0eb cream canvas, #006241 brand green, #1e3932 dark bands, #cba258 gold rewards — four-tier green system)
cozy_brown (Cafe: #f9f7f5 warm surface, #5d4432 primary brown, #3e2b1e dark text — quiet coffee-shop warmth)
urban_monochrome (Uber Eats: #ffffff + #000000 binary, #efefef chip gray, whisper shadows — delivery efficiency)

editorial_farm_fresh (Sweetgreen: #f4f3e7 cream base, #00473c brand green, #0e1512 dark header, #e6ff55 neon CTA accent, #d8e5d6 sage, #e8dcc6 peach — sophisticated farm-to-table, editorial confidence through minimalism)

earthy_warm_industrial (Chipotle: #ffffff base, #451400 maroon text everywhere, #ad2118 red CTAs, #b68207 gold accents, #f0f0f0 light gray — Mexican grill warmth, industrial efficiency, earthy brand color as text color)

bold_minimal_classic (Shake Shack: #ffffff dominant, #000000 black CTAs and text, #707070 muted gray — burger joint confidence, geometric typography carries the brand, minimal color lets food photos pop)

statement_seasonal_dark (Dig Inn: #f9f6eb cream, #1a1a1a near-black sections, #000000 pure black marquee, #005740 green CTAs, #e6f0e7 mint, #a8d6ae light green — dark/light color-block rhythm, massive type, seasonal fresh energy)
typography_mood: tight_proprietary (Starbucks: SoDoSans -0.01em tracking everywhere, 50px pill buttons, weight 600 headings)
expressive_poppins (Cafe: Poppins with wide weight range, desktop-first scale, JetBrains Mono for code)
bold_geometric (Uber: UberMove Bold 700 exclusively for headlines, UberMoveText Medium 500 for UI — strict two-font hierarchy)

editorial_serif_sans (Sweetgreen: SweetSansText for body (400 weight), Grenette serif for display moments, 16px h1 at 400 weight — tiny, confident, magazine-like. h2 at 24px with 0.72px letter-spacing. Category tabs at 48px ultra-light 200 weight.)
rounded_friendly (Chipotle: Nunito 500 weight for all headings — rounded, approachable, fast-casual friendly. Trade Gothic for hero buttons. Single weight (500) throughout creates consistent warmth.)

geometric_statement (Shake Shack: Jost 700 weight for all h1-h3 headings — modern geometric sans, 47px h1 at 56px line-height, 30px h2 at 34px line-height, 24px h3 at 30px line-height. Black-on-white bold typography.)

massive_condensed (Dig Inn: Flama at 750 weight for h1 (90px / 86.4px line-height), 700 weight for h2 (120px / 115.2px line-height), 700 weight for h3 (30px). Type-first design where headings fill the viewport. Most aggressive scale in the restaurant industry.)
layout_density: color_block_rhythm (Starbucks: cream -> white -> dark green sections alternate, creating visual cadence)
spacious_cozy (Cafe: generous whitespace on warm canvas, 2/4/8/12/16/24/32/48 spacing scale)
efficient_urban (Uber: compact, information-dense, transit-system clarity — content packed but never cluttered)
editorial_airy (Sweetgreen: generous whitespace on cream, two-up columns with image reveal, collection grids, content max-width ~1280px)
section_dense (Chipotle: information-loaded sections, video hero taking full viewport, AEM component-based pages, content blocks stacked vertically with minimal spacing)
slider_sparse (Shake Shack: carousel hero dominates, minimal content density, food photography is the primary content, large type over images)
dark_light_rhythm (Dig Inn: dark -> dark -> black -> mint -> cream -> light green — aggressive color-block alternation, each section full viewport height, marquee text breaks, massive type)

button_radius_spectrum.sharp_4px: Chipotle — all buttons (ORDER NOW, CREATE AN ACCOUNT, SIGN IN) use 4px border-radius. Rectangular, industrial, efficient. The only major restaurant brand rejecting the pill convention.
button_radius_spectrum.pill_30px: Shake Shack — primary black CTA uses 30px. Rounded but restrained.
button_radius_spectrum.pill_32px: Dig Inn — secondary CTAs (Order Now on dark, Order catering, Build your own bowl, Explore Our Mission) at 32px. Slightly rounded pill.
button_radius_spectrum.pill_50px: Starbucks — classic restaurant pill. The reference standard.
button_radius_spectrum.pill_60px: Dig Inn — primary green 'Order Now' at 60px. Extra generous, highly clickable, statement-level CTA.
button_radius_spectrum.pill_1000px: Sweetgreen — 'Order now' neon green pill, essentially full-capsule. The extreme end of the spectrum.

menu_page.best_practices: Category tabs/pills for menu sections, product cards with photo + name + calories + price, dietary badges, quick-add to order. Sweetgreen uses ultra-light 200-weight 48px category names. Chipotle uses anchor-based menu navigation.

product_detail_page.best_practices: Floating add-to-order button, nutritional facts table with two-column label/value rows, size selector with visual cup icons

rewards_page.best_practices: Gold accent exclusively for Rewards ceremony, tier status panels in dark brand color, star/point accumulation visuals. Chipotle Rewards, Dig Inn Rewards, Shake Shack — all major fast-casual brands now have rewards programs.

locations_page.best_practices: Prominent search with geolocation, map + list dual view, store cards with address + hours + distance + directions CTA, mobile-first (most restaurant traffic searches locations on phone). All 4 new brands (Sweetgreen, Chipotle, Shake Shack, Dig Inn) have dedicated location finders.
